title: A Tiny Flying Machine Meets a Giant Rocket
summary:
A tiny flying machine hovered in the sky at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Behind it stood a giant rocket. The photo was Space.com's space photo of the day for November 9.

In front is the Jetson ONE. It is a small electric aircraft made for just one person. It was built by Jetson, a company in the United States. Behind it stands the top part of Blue Origin's huge New Glenn rocket.

The photo was taken during an event called MAX POWER. The event brought together people with new ideas and new technology. The Jetson ONE was flying at the UP.Summit, part of the big event. People watched as the little aircraft moved through the air and stayed still in one place.

Jetson is making small electric aircraft for one person to travel short trips. New Glenn is built to carry things far beyond Earth. One machine is made for a single rider. The other is made to leave the planet. Together, they show that flight can mean very different things.
why_it_matters: It shows that flying machines can be small enough for one person, so one day you might travel in the sky in a whole new way.
